India Blocked Betting Sites Using Forged Court Orders, Report Says

India ordered the blocking of 129 online betting websites based on two forged high court orders, according to a Reuters report cited by The Pioneer and Times Now. The specific details of the forged orders and the process by which they were used to effect the blocking were not further elaborated in the provided coverage.
